# Typers contributor instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the [Typers documentation](../docs/typers/README.md).

This is the Typers fork. Its native compiler is in `tsc/`; root build scripts refer to the legacy compiler. Use validation for the component being modified. The [original Microsoft guidance](../docs/typers/upstream/copilot-instructions.original.md) is historical context, not a maintenance-only policy for Typers.
